records.reason: You become hidden from a target after a Strike — a visibility state resolved at the table; no sheet statistic changes.
Upgrades the outcome of the Grit and Tenacity reaction's reroll; a degree shift applied to a roll made at the table, not a stat.
A 2-action Spellstrike activity; all of its damage lands on other creatures. The action is already listed from its actionCost.
Free action that auto-succeeds one unstable flat check; a roll replacement resolved at the table.
An additive applied when you make an alchemical item; it steps that consumable's own initial dice at use time and imposes a save on the activator — nothing on the character sheet.
A Strike activity whose only effect is –2 circumstance penalties to the ENEMY's Fortitude/Reflex DCs (target-side).

The record carries untrainedProficiency {levelMinus:2}, but untrainedSkillBonus (src/rules/derive.ts:305-315) computes level − levelMinus with no scaling, so the player is stuck at level−2 forever; the printed feat improves to level−1 at 5th and full level at 7th. The lane needs a level-keyed levelMinus (or a scale table) before this feat can be delivered correctly.

Passive defensive benefit that nothing delivers: saves against sleep effects are treated as one degree of success better. (The 1-round reduction to mental-effect durations stays table-side — no lane and no numeric stat.) 'one degree of success better' is an established situational bonus phrase (iron-lung, just-the-facts).

situational.when: against an effect that would make you fall asleep
situational.bonus: treat your result as one degree of success better

records.reason: Extends the duration of Humanoid Form / Illusory Disguise at the cost of drained; play-time duration bookkeeping the app does not model.

A real defensive grant the sheet never shows: while in medium or heavy armor your guardian's armor resistance becomes 6 + half your level. Guardian's Armor itself carries no resistances field either, so nothing anywhere gives the player this physical resistance. Expressed as a mode because IwrEntry has no condition field and the benefit is gated on armor category.

mode.name: Unyielding Force (medium/heavy armor)
mode.duration: while wearing medium or heavy armor
mode.note: Unyielding Force: while you wear medium or heavy armor, your guardian's armor resistance to physical damage is 6 + half your level.

records.reason: Exploration activity: Track at full Speed in urban areas and use Society or Survival to Track. No proficiency or bonus changes.
Reaction that either gives you a wellspring slot (existing archetype bookkeeping) or inflicts a surge on the triggering ENEMY.
An action that rolls an existing skill on the Perform result table; its effect is GM-adjudicated attitude/DC influence.
Reaction trading a failed save for a success plus blindness; resolved at the table when it triggers.

Passive defence nothing delivers: you are not off-guard to hidden, undetected, or flanking creatures of your level or lower (nor to surprise attack). No numeric field fits, but the situational lane carries exactly this kind of AC-condition star (cf. sturdy-neck-stock, talonstrike-blade).

situational.when: vs hidden, undetected, flanking or surprise-attacking foes of your level or lower
situational.bonus: you aren't off-guard to them (while you can act)

records.reason: Permission to Hide and Sneak without cover or concealment in your Terrain Stalker terrain; the app models neither cover nor terrain state.
A reaction chain with your spotter; the off-guard condition it produces lands on the FOE and depends on an ally's roll.

Grants critical specialization with bo staff, longbow, composite longbow, scythe and staff and the record carries nothing. The remaster equivalent duskwalker-weapon-familiarity already ships exactly this shape (critSpec + critSpecWeapons.bases with the same five ids, critSpecLevel 5); this legacy Ancestry Guide feat is level 5 itself, so no critSpecLevel is needed. All five ids verified in core.json.
A 2-action Command an Animal activity; the movement and Leaps belong to the mount and are resolved at the table.
Grants lesser cover to you and allies inside the swarm's space — positional cover, which the app does not track at all.
Reaction Strike; the off-guard it causes is on the triggering enemy.
A sustained 2-action attack activity dealing damage to targets with a save against DCs the sheet already computes.
Reaction (or free action on a crit) to make a melee Strike; an action resolved at the table.
A 2-action burst spending sanguimancy HP to damage foes; uses the existing class DC / spell DC, nothing on the sheet changes.
An Interact action to store a poison dose for your venomous spit; the poison's effect lands on the target.

Wielded blowguns and slings gain the venomous trait — a permanent change to the player's weapons that nothing delivers. There is no lane to add a trait to a MANUFACTURED weapon (unarmedTraits is unarmed-only, and core.json's 'venomous' trait record is a bare stub with no description), so the strike line and the item's trait list never show it.
Two social identities plus a special DC others roll Perception against, and a downtime Tell Me More action; social/GM-side, no sheet statistic.
Swaps your creature traits (plant for humanoid) and grants the Verdant Rest downtime action; no numeric effect and creature traits only matter to effects the GM applies.
A 3-action Ready variant with a 10-minute cooldown; entirely an encounter action.
Reaction that creates a 15-foot web of difficult terrain around you; battlefield terrain plus damage to creatures moving through it. (Duplicate legacy-text record of vermillion-threads.)
Reaction creating difficult terrain you can ignore and walk on for 1 minute; terrain and target damage, no persistent speed or stat grant.

Grants +1 spell slot at every Red Mantis rank except your two highest — real player-facing slots. spellSlotBonus {perRank:1, exceptHighest:2, entryId} is the right shape, but the Red Mantis assassin archetype is NOT in CASTER_ARCHETYPES (src/rules/casterArchetypes.ts), so there is no Red Mantis casting entry or slot pool to increase; the field would be silently inert. (The resurrection counteract DC is GM-side.)

Adds selectable damage types to your Elemental Blasts (air/fire cold, earth/wood poison, metal electricity, water acid). deriveBlastStrikes (src/rules/derive.ts ~1537) hardcodes one damage type per element from ELEMENT_BLAST with no alternative, and no record field can add blast damage types, so the sheet can never show the type the player chose.

Lets you prepare either Harm or Heal in every divine-font slot. build.ts pins the font entry to a single type ({type: build.divineFont}) and SpellsTab renders that one spell for each pip, so half the feat's slots are shown as the wrong spell. The battle-font 'allowed' list is the existing mechanism, but nothing keys it to this feat — no record field can express it.

Delivered by the Spells tab repertoire editor, which lets a spontaneous caster set/change the signature spell of each rank at any time (SpellsTab.tsx signature picker) — exactly what changing one signature spell at daily preparations amounts to.
A daily-preparation option to leave one slot unprepared and fill it mid-Spellstrike; prepared-slot bookkeeping the player does at the table, no stat change.
Extra Sneak distance and relaxed end-of-Sneak cover requirements; movement/visibility rules the app does not model.
Sneak at full Speed and Hide/Sneak without cover or concealment; same untracked movement/visibility lane.

Upgrades every follower you have to a veteran follower (better statistics than experienced). Followers ARE modelled as companions (content.followers, CompanionKind 'follower'), and COMPANION_MODS is the registry for feats that modify an existing companion — a note-only entry is the established pattern there (cf. stealthy-companion). Today the feat changes nothing on the follower blocks.

companionMod.note: Veteran Follower: all of your followers become veteran followers — the veteran quality's better statistics replace the experienced ones on each follower block.

records.reason: A spellshape action; the push and prone land on creatures around your familiar via their Reflex saves.
Once per 10 minutes your Feint compares against all adjacent creatures' Perception DCs; an action's targeting rule resolved at the table, with no bonus to the Deception check.
A free action with its own Crafting-check outcome table that shifts a subsequent Coerce; the whole thing is rolled at the table and the feat is already listed as an action.
A 2-action Strike activity; the drained condition lands on the target.

A permanent damage rider on the player's own fangs Strike (granted by vampire-dedication's grantedStrikes) that nothing delivers: 1d6 persistent bleed on a critical hit, 2d6 at 14th, 3d6 at 20th. No field attaches a crit rider to an existing granted strike, but strikeDamage situational stars carry exactly this kind of rider (cf. artery-map's '1d6 persistent bleed').

situational.when: on a critical hit with your vampire fangs Strike

records.reason: Steps the ratfolk jaws unarmed attack from 1d4 to 1d6 and adds the backstabber trait; the record carries nothing. unarmedTraits with match+stepDie is the exact lane (cf. the 'hair'/'lash' entries). Note the base strike is missing too — PC2 Ratfolk's Sharp Teeth (jaws 1d4 piercing, brawling, agile, finesse) is absent from the ratfolk ancestry record, so that grantedStrikes gap must be closed as well for this fix to bite; the trait/step form is used deliberately so it can never double-grant a jaws attack.

Teaches your animal companion the Vicious Rend activity (two claw/fist/pincer/talon Strikes, +1d6 if both hit, 2d6 when specialized) and nothing records it. COMPANION_MODS is the registry for feats that modify an existing companion and note-only entries are its established pattern (stealthy-companion), so the companion block should carry it.

companionMod.note: Vicious Rend (2 actions): your companion makes two claw, fist, pincer, or talon Strikes against the same target, applying its multiple attack penalty as normal; if both hit, the target takes an extra 1d6 damage (2d6 if your companion is specialized).

records.reason: A 2-action Strike activity (extra weapon damage die, counts as two attacks for MAP); an action resolved at the table, already surfaced by its actionCost.
Adds the virulent trait to your venom — it changes how the TARGET saves to reduce the affliction's stage, not any statistic of yours.

Reaction granting temporary HP equal to your Con modifier until the end of your next turn; transient play state entered on the HP control (no temp-HP lane, and none is wanted for a per-trigger amount).
Two identities plus a special DC (20 + proficiency) that OTHERS roll Perception against; social/GM-side bookkeeping with no sheet statistic.
An activity that makes drilled ALLIES Raise a Shield; changes only allies' AC, at the table.
A spellshape action granting temporary HP to you and affected allies when you cast Courageous Anthem; transient play state tied to casting.
A save attempted at the moment you would gain drained; conditions are applied by the player at the table and the app has no lane for a condition-avoidance roll.
Changes the damage TYPE your harm spell deals to celestial targets (legacy alignment damage); it only matters against the target's IWR.
Mythic reaction spending a Mythic Point: rolls one save at mythic proficiency and damages the enemy caster; entirely resolved when triggered.
A deviant attack action (and its awakening upgrades) using existing class/spell DCs; damage and grabbed land on targets.
A 1-action area attack after Unleash your Psyche; damage to creatures in the area with a save.
A Strike that forces the TARGET to re-save against a disease or poison already afflicting it, with a –4 penalty on a crit; wholly target-side.
A fortune effect letting you roll one saving throw or skill check twice; a reroll used at the table, not a modifier.
An action granting temporary HP equal to level + Cha until the start of your next turn; transient play state entered on the HP control.
